title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.28585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. translated_title: SceneRig：一个从单张图像重建可直接仿真用3D场景的智能体系统
translated_abstract: 仿真是机器人领域的一个强大工具，但大规模构建多样化、可直接用于仿真的场景仍然十分困难。从单张图像重建场景是一种有前景的替代方案，但仅有视觉上的相似是不够的：物体还必须被恢复、被准确放置，并具备物理上的支撑。依赖事后物理沉降的现有方法常常会错误放置物体，产生的场景看起来正确，但在物体操作时表现不佳。我们提出了SceneRig，一个能将单张图像转化为可编辑、可直接用于仿真的场景的智能体系统。SceneRig结合几何、视觉和物理工具来重建忠实的3D场景，随后由智能体在物理仿真器中执行“编辑-验证”循环以实现物理稳定性。在多样化的输入上，SceneRig提升了实例分割、以物体为中心的外观以及3D放置的效果，同时保持重建场景的物理稳定性。
tldr: SceneRig是一个智能体系统，通过结合几何、视觉与物理工具，并在物理仿真器中进行“编辑-验证”循环，将单张图像转化为可编辑、物理稳定且可直接用于仿真的3D场景。
en_tdlr: SceneRig is an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, physically stable, simulation-ready 3D scene by combining geometric, visual, and physical tools with edit-and-validate loops in a physics simulator.
